s1.text: What if you could control your computer, without touching it?

s2b.text: A hands-free desktop control system, powered by real-time computer vision.

s3a.text: Move your index finger to control the cursor.

s3d.text: Simple, intuitive gestures replace traditional mouse interactions.

s4a.text: Head tracking adds another layer of control.

s4b.text: Turn your head to navigate between pages, and use simple movements to trigger actions.

s5.text: And when you need to type, Gestura brings up a virtual keyboard that you can control entirely through gestures.

s7b.text: Control your computer, without touching it.
